description: Figure 3 illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from the Whisper large-v3 model after a series of cumulative automated optimisation steps. The horizontal axis represents the optimisation step number, labeled linearly from 0 to 7, with tick marks at each integer value. The vertical axis represents the difference in WER, labeled as “Difference in WER (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from -2.0 to 2.0, and tick marks at 0.5 intervals.  A single blue line is plotted, representing the WER difference at each optimisation step. The line begins at approximately 0.1% at step 0, decreases to approximately -1.6% at step 3, then increases to approximately -0.8% at step 7. The line is not shaded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the bars are sorted sequentially by optimisation step number.
